description: This file defines event handling logic for 3D objects in a React Three Fiber context, including intersection detection, event propagation, and pointer capture management.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for an intersection event based on object UUID, index, and instance ID.

methods.name: releaseInternalPointerCapture
methods.description: Releases pointer capture for a specific object and pointer ID, updating internal maps and calling releasePointerCapture on the target.

methods.name: removeInteractivity
methods.description: Removes all references and event data related to a specific object from the internal interaction state.

methods.name: createEvents
methods.description: Creates and returns an object with event handling functions for pointer events, managing intersection detection, event propagation, and pointer capture logic.
